places.name: Pattaya Beach
places.ai_summary: A bustling beach offering water sports, sunbathing, and a vibrant nightlife scene.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and enjoy water sports like jet skiing.

places.place_tip: Be cautious of your belongings in crowded areas.

places.ai_summary: A magnificent wooden structure showcasing intricate carvings that reflect Thai culture and spirituality.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available at the entrance.

places.ai_summary: A miniature park featuring replicas of Thailand's famous landmarks and structures.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Great for photos; consider a visit to the nearby Siam Cultural Park.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Flag of Thailand.svg

attribution.title: Flag of Thailand
attribution.author: Zscout370
attribution.credit:
Own work based on: https://www.nstda.or.th/th/nstda-knowledge/11557-thaiflag-color

Construction sheet of the flag of Thailand
attribution.description:
The national flag of Kingdom of Thailand; there are total of 3 colours:
Red represents the blood spilt to protect Thailand’s independence and often more simply described as representing the nation.
White represents the religion of Buddhism, the predominant religion of the nation
Blue represents the monarchy of the nation, which is recognised as the centre of Thai hearts.

places.name: Big Buddha Hill (Wat Phra Yai)
places.ai_summary: A hilltop temple featuring a giant Buddha statue and offering panoramic views of Pattaya.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Dress respectfully as it is a religious site.
